channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-17411 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.6
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.6 | IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow an authenticated attacker to view, add, modify, or delete information in the back-end database due to SQL injection. Input is not properly neutralized before it is used in database queries.

item.title: CVE-2026-17428 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.0
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.0 | IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper authorization. Values supplied in the request URL are used in authorization decisions without sufficient verification, which could allow access to information belonging to others.

item.title: CVE-2026-18535 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.6
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.6 | IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 are vulnerable to a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) attack and to improper neutralisation of wildcard query operators.

item.title: CVE-2026-18689 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow an authenticated user to obtain limited information about other organizations due to incorrect authorization. A token issued for a limited purpose is accepted where it should not be, which could reveal the names of other organizations.

item.title: CVE-2026-18836 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.3
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.3 | IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to server-side request forgery. The affected component can be made to send requests to unintended destinations and return the response to the attacker.

item.title: CVE-2026-18838 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.4
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.4 | IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information and modify API configurations due to improper authentication. Identity information supplied in requests is not sufficiently verified, which could allow a caller to impersonate another user.

item.title: CVE-2026-19121 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.3
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.3 | IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow an authenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access due to improper authorization. Tenant context is not sufficiently verified against the authenticated user, which could allow access to another tenant's resources.

item.title: CVE-2026-19122 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 3.8
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 3.8 | IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow an authenticated privileged attacker to send unauthorized requests from the system due to server-side request forgery. This could be used to enumerate network resources or to support further attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-19124 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 could allow an attacker with access to stored data to decrypt sensitive credentials due to the use of a hard-coded cryptographic key. The key protecting stored credentials is built into the product, so credentials could be decrypted if the stored data is obtained.

item.title: CVE-2026-19126 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 uses weaker than expected cryptographic algorithms that could allow an attacker to decrypt highly sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2026-19128 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow an authenticated attacker to send unauthorized requests from the system due to server-side request forgery. This could be used to enumerate network resources or to support further attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-19129 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a network-positioned attacker to intercept backup data due to improper verification of the backup server's identity. The identity of the backup server is not verified when the secure connection for analytics backups is established, which could allow backup data, and credentials if used, to be intercepted.

item.title: CVE-2026-19131 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow low-privileged users to query arbitrary indices and read sensitive data due to missing authorization.

item.title: CVE-2026-75590 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to access internal network resources and obtain sensitive information due to server-side request forgery. A protection that blocks requests to internal addresses can be bypassed, so the server could be made to contact internal services and return part of their responses.

item.title: CVE-2026-93779 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.2 via the init_routes due to missing validation on a user controlled key. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to read paid course lesson and topic content without enrollment, retrieve quiz answer keys including the is_correct field before attempting a quiz, and enumerate the email addresses, usernames, and registration data of other users including instructors and administrators. Exploitation requires that the attacker hold a valid Tutor LMS API key/secret pair, which is issued to subscriber-level users through the plugin's API key management feature.

item.title: CVE-2026-93902 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The Soledad theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Social Profile Fields in all versions up to, and including, 8.7.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload is scoped to the attacker's own user meta but is exposed publicly on their author archive page at /author/<slug>/, which is accessible to unauthenticated visitors regardless of whether the attacker has published any posts.

item.title: CVE-2026-9601 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The Stackable – Page Builder Gutenberg Blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'update_block_style' endpoint in all versions up to, and including, 3.19.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

item.title: CVE-2025-15708 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Live Composer WordPress plugin before 2.1.23 does not sanitise and escape some of its custom post type slug settings before using them in front-end links, which could allow high privilege users such as admin to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks even when the unfiltered_html capability is disallowed (for example in a multisite setup).

item.title: CVE-2026-117525 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.57.7212 does not escape shortcode attribute values embedded in comments before rendering them into the media player markup, allowing an unauthenticated visitor to store a script payload in a comment that executes in the session of any visitor, including an administrator, who plays the commented video, when the non-default comment-shortcode-parsing setting is enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-117588 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WP Google Review Slider WordPress plugin before 18.11 does not perform nonce validation when updating its active Google Places configuration, allowing attackers to alter or destroy that configuration via a forged request, provided they can trick a site administrator into following a crafted link.

item.title: CVE-2026-118528 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not validate that the requesting user owns the referenced listing before returning its metadata via an AJAX action, allowing authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access and above to disclose another user's private and unpublished draft listing details, including contact information.

item.title: CVE-2026-118529 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not verify that a user owns a listing before processing a featured-listing checkout for it, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to publish and feature another user's pending listing when the featured listing fee is set to zero.

item.title: CVE-2026-118530 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not check that the acting user may edit each targeted user when handling an email-verification bulk action on multisite, allowing an Administrator of one site on the network to lock out users of other sites, including the network Super Administrator, until they re-verify their email.

item.title: CVE-2026-118532 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not verify ownership of attachment IDs supplied when updating a listing's images, allowing authenticated users with Subscriber-level access and above to permanently delete arbitrary media library attachments, including those uploaded by administrators, along with their files.

item.title: CVE-2026-118533 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not verify that the user requesting an order's payment receipt owns that order, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to disclose other users' order and payment information, including amounts, payment method, payment status and transaction ID.

item.title: CVE-2026-118534 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11 does not verify that the order targeted by its checkout payment-retry REST action belongs to the requesting user, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to create payment-attempt records against other users' orders.

item.title: CVE-2026-119073 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Live Composer WordPress plugin before 2.1.23 does not escape a pagination setting supplied through its post-listing module shortcodes before outputting it in an HTML attribute, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-121379 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Tournamatch WordPress plugin before 4.7.1 does not validate or restrict the path of a previously stored profile or team image before deleting it when a new image is uploaded, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to delete arbitrary files on the server, such as wp-config.php, which can lead to a full site takeover.

item.title: CVE-2026-121380 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Tournamatch WordPress plugin before 4.7.1 does not restrict access to its team invitation listing, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve the email addresses of people invited to join teams.

item.title: CVE-2026-121491 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 does not validate or escape a request header before writing it into a PHP file it regenerates on an unprotected admin hook, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code when its custom database error page is enabled and they win a race against an administrator saving its settings.

item.title: CVE-2026-121492 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 does not have authorisation checks in some of its AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to change the order of arbitrary posts, including drafts, private posts and navigation menu items, as well as the order of taxonomy terms when term ordering is enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-121796 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Add From Server Lite WordPress plugin before 6.0.0 does not restrict SVG uploads to users allowed to post unfiltered HTML, allowing users with the Author role and above to upload SVG files containing JavaScript and perform Stored XSS attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-121848 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Magic Link WordPress plugin before 2.2.6 does not check that the user requesting a login link is authorised to generate one for the chosen account, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to generate a working login link for an administrator and log in as them.

item.title: CVE-2026-121857 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner WordPress plugin before 3.1.14 does not check that a user may manage WooCommerce orders before returning or removing ticket data for any order, allowing any role an administrator has granted access to the Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner WordPress plugin before 3.1.14's admin area (down to Subscriber) to view other customers' ticket codes and names and to remove tickets from their orders.

item.title: CVE-2026-121858 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner WordPress plugin before 3.2.9 does not properly escape a search value before using it in SQL queries in several of its admin listings, allowing users with access to its admin area (administrators by default, or any role granted access in its settings) to perform SQL injection attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-121866 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The iLeads SMS Gateway by Exsile WordPress plugin before 2.0.0 does not check capabilities or nonces in several AJAX actions that update a site option chosen by the request, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to change arbitrary WordPress options and escalate to administrator, for example by enabling registration with administrator as the default role.

item.title: CVE-2026-122001 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Komfortkasse for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.4.9 does not properly validate the authenticity of REST API requests, overriding WordPress's own nonce verification so that a request forged in a logged-in administrator's browser is accepted, which can be used to create a new administrator account and fully take over the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-97189 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not perform a read-permission check when it renders and formats the values of its relational fields, allowing users with post-editing access (Contributor and above) to disclose the titles and non-public statuses of other users' unpublished posts.

item.title: CVE-2026-97190 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not verify that a user is allowed to edit the target object before writing to it during bidirectional relationship synchronization, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to add or remove a reference to their own object on arbitrary posts, users, or terms they cannot otherwise edit.

item.title: CVE-2026-97191 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Saturday 7 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not re-apply its field-group location rules when persisting values submitted through the post editor save path, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to write custom fields the site restricted to administrators onto their own posts.
